items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: I think I hardly would know anybody left in the band. I mean Bill Hughes and John Williams probably.

ctx.x: Well there’s a whole library of stuff that nobody plays like Basie. Even the current Basie band doesn’t play it as well as they were. Although the new Basie band is not all that bad.
I haven’t heard them for a while. I think I hardly would know anybody left in the band. I mean Bill Hughes and John Williams probably.
